_doc: Per-model animation fixes applied by fix_clips.mjs to swarm/models/*.glb. Swarm idles on the first clip matching /idle|stand|breath/ (else clip 0) and walks on /walk|run|move|locomotion/, so names decide what plays. Found by review_models.cjs on 2026-11-20. Ops: rename [from, to]; drop name; idleFrom {clip, at seconds}: a new 'Idle' that holds a calm pose from that clip with a slow sway; inPlace name: remove root travel so the walk stays on the spot.

Shellpack.glb.why: the idle was the curled-in-shell pose for the whole loop; the creature was never visible standing still

Cloudpuff.glb.why: the idle shrank the body to a speck then ballooned it about 10x

Generoot.glb.why: 0.07 s T-pose, so Generoot stood frozen with arms out
a stagger-and-collapse clip, not a run; it ended lying on the ground

FloraKnight.glb.why: a 4.4 s sword-and-shield combo with a leap, played as both idle and walk

Purseus.glb.why: a hovering, gesturing loop: fine standing still, wrong as a walk

Pylord.glb.why: a 5.4 s overhead punch, played as the walk

Jawby.glb.why: only a Move clip, so it swam in place while idle

Staticap.glb.why: only a Move clip, so it walked in place while idle

SquireBud.glb.why: only a Running clip, so it ran in place while idle

Frostag.glb.why: only a Running clip, so it ran in place while idle

Pursula.glb.why: only a Running clip, so it ran in place while idle

Bearzooka.glb.why: the walk travelled 1.7 body lengths and snapped back every 6.8 s

Bleetstrike.glb.why: the walk travelled 1.3 body lengths and snapped back each loop
